description: Source code for an Android audio effect library implementing downmixing effects, including functions for downmixing various multichannel audio formats to stereo, effect parameter handling, and effect lifecycle management.

methods.name: Downmix_foldFromQuad
methods.description: Downmixes quad audio to stereo by averaging front and rear channels.

methods.name: Downmix_foldFromSurround
methods.description: Downmixes surround (mono rear) audio to stereo with volume adjustments.

methods.name: Downmix_foldFrom5Point1
methods.description: Downmixes 5.1 audio to stereo, combining front, center, LFE, and rear channels.

methods.name: Downmix_foldFrom7Point1
methods.description: Downmixes 7.1 audio to stereo, combining all channels including side and rear.

methods.name: Downmix_foldGeneric
methods.description: Generic downmix for multichannel audio with arbitrary channel masks.

methods.name: Downmix_setParameter
methods.description: Sets parameters for the downmix effect, such as downmix type.

methods.name: Downmix_getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves parameters of the downmix effect.

methods.name: Downmix_Init
methods.description: Initializes the downmix context with default parameters.

methods.name: Downmix_Configure
methods.description: Configures input/output audio settings for the effect.

methods.name: Downmix_Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the downmix context.
